title: Bank RFP economics and relationship recommendation
prompt:
Evaluate three banks' operating, treasury, and credit proposals on a fully loaded basis.

Begin with the July liquidity, banking, and covenant-outlook thread in `Requests/`, including the bank follow-up. Use the current controller-tied workpapers and operating extracts, keeping earlier versions only for comparison. Resolve conflicts using dates, approvals, document status, and management correspondence. Reconcile posted Alder Ridge balances through the contractor-accounting MCP; keep external targets, peer data, bank terms, and market evidence tied to their controlling finance sources.

Combine account-analysis fees, earnings credit, card rebates, lockbox and ACH pricing, revolver spread and unused fees, implementation cost, and documented transition risk. Use forecast service volumes and average borrowings rather than current-month volumes. Calculate annual net cost for each bank, switching payback from the incumbent, and the recommended relationship after enforcing mandatory service capabilities.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `bank_A_annual_net_cost`, `bank_B_annual_net_cost`, `bank_C_annual_net_cost`, `recommended_bank`, `switching_payback_months`. Use dollars to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals, and lists as JSON arrays.
